_: Name, description and badge live in src/resources/connectors.json so the console and the browser process cannot disagree about them.

notes: PKCE with S256 is supported and should be used - this is a desktop client, so there is no place to keep a client secret.
data.records:write is deliberately absent. A base an agent can write to is a base a misread column can corrupt silently, and nothing in the catalogue needs it.
schema.bases:read is required as well as the records scope; without it field names come back as ids and the data is unusable.

rate_limits.note: Per base. Exceeding it returns 429 and Airtable then refuses for 30 seconds, so backing off immediately matters more than usual.
